source.ny: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance, Publication 718 (2/25), effective March 1, 2025, combined state+local rates by county; ZIP-to-county from Census 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship (largest land-area overlap). Yonkers ZIPs 10701-10705 and 10710 use the Yonkers 8.875% city rate. Unique/firm ZIPs in NYC borough prefixes 100-104, 111-114, and 116 that are not ZCTAs are filled at the NYC 8.875% rate.
source.pa: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: 6% state motor vehicle sales tax, plus 2% local for vehicles registered in Philadelphia and 1% in Allegheny County. ZIP-to-county from Census 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship; all mapped PA ZIPs are stored (6% outside Philadelphia and Allegheny).
